method.work: Actual private FIFO adapter generator yields counted; no production source rewrite or alternate codec.
method.processMemory: Node process.memoryUsage before, after, after explicit GC where --expose-gc is provided; sampled every 64 yielded steps. Harness records, two engines, old/staged/new roots and encoded strings share one process. Sampled maxima are observed only at yielded-step samples plus the pre-operation baseline, not continuous peaks or isolated component bytes. Post-operation readings are reported separately. Work counts report emitted yielded steps; a failing attempted charge may not be emitted.
method.limitations: Bounded operational rejections are retained as Rejected with their typed error and exact old-root preservation; they are not successful round trips. One raw sample per case, no latency qualification, browser heap, internal primitive peaks, allocation profiler, percentiles or universal capacity claim. Serialized bytes are UTF-8 JSON size; graph/object counts are not heap bytes.

identityMethod: Parent records frozen final source/compiler output identities after sampler completion; independent package audit compares current compiled bytes. Production source held stable throughout final cost run; no source rewrite for measurement.
